_meta._note: Chapter 63, Final test (ch63-test, new). Twelve multiple-choice questions at 80 % (9/12 fails, 10/12 passes): the head's case and the meaning of a definite / indefinite second term (q01–02), the dual in the nominative and the oblique (q03–04), the sound masculine plural in the nominative and the oblique (q05–06), a chain of three and an adjective attached to the right noun (q07–08), why a ن goes missing for a noun and for a five verb with لَنْ (q09–10), and one decision from each part of Ash-Shams (q11–12). Correct options are placed 3 / 3 / 3 / 3. Added 2026-10-04 in the proposal harvest, batch 8 (Docs/proposals/proposal-harvest-tracker.md), from Docs/proposals/chapter-63-content-proposal.md and its review amendments.

ayah.label: Ash-Shams 91:13
ayah.ar: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ نَاقَةَ اللَّهِ وَسُقْيَاهَا
ayah.en: And the messenger of Allāh [i.e., Ṣāliḥ] said to them, "[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allāh or [prevent her from] her drink."
ayah.ur: تو خدا کے پیغمبر (صالح) نے ان سے کہا کہ خدا کی اونٹنی اور اس کے پانی پینے کی باری سے عذر کرو
